title: DraftForge format specification
description: Describes the required section structure, citation style, heading numbering, front-matter, and caption rules a drafted document must comply with. Validated programmatically (see src/draftforge/formats/validator.py) -- never by an LLM.

spec_id.description: Stable, unique, filesystem/URL-safe identifier for this spec.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the UI spec picker.

version.description: Semver-ish string for the spec revision, e.g. '1.0.0'.

sections.description: Ordered, top-level required sections of the document body (front matter and references/bibliography formatting are handled separately below).

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the spec, used as the leaf/section key throughout the pipeline.

title.description: Section heading text (numbering, if any, is applied on top of this at render/validate time).

required.description: If false, the section/subsection is optional; its absence from a produced document is not a violation.

max_heading_depth.description: Deepest Markdown ATX heading level ('#' count) permitted to appear inside this section's own drafted text.

word_range.description: Target word-count range for this section's own drafted prose. Null means not word-count checked (e.g. an auto-generated references section).

allow_extra_subsections.description: If true, subsections beyond the required/optional ones listed here are permitted without triggering a violation.

subsections.description: Recursive child sections (chapter -> section -> subsection, etc.).

style_id.description: Short identifier for the citation style, e.g. 'ieee', 'apa'.

csl_file.description: Path (relative to the specs/ directory) to the CSL style file Pandoc should use for citeproc rendering.

marker_style.description: The in-prose citation marker syntax drafters must emit. Only Pandoc's '[@bibkey]' form is supported (see spec.md constraint #2: citations are keys, never free text).

style.description: 'decimal' requires headings to carry a numeric prefix (e.g. '2.1 Title'); 'none' requires headings to carry no numeric prefix.

start_level.description: Heading level at which numbering begins (levels above this, if any, e.g. an unnumbered part title, are exempt).

title_page_fields.description: Required title-page metadata field names, e.g. ['title', 'author', 'institution'].

min_words.description: Minimum word count of the caption's descriptive text (excluding the prefix/number).
